grouped_fixture_evidence.receipt_check: Stim counts native integer health rather than uses; fractional/zero/wrong-mode reports, exact target, XP/item/successor and retry are correct
All eight BR weapon/cash/cache pickup stages consume original aggregated fields, clamp targets and preserve retries without MP-mode cross-credit
Five BR gas/driving/non-downed timers preserve fractional units and retries; seconds/minutes do not round up from milliseconds
Five BR revive/Gulag stages distinguish the actor, self-revival and win/loss; malformed flags, MP mode and retries cannot duplicate credit

blocker_groups.required_original_contract: Count successful stuns of enemy players from the native stun producer and packed result.
blocker_groups.missing_contract: Parser acceptance does not establish which count/result distinguishes enemy stuns from other affected actors or duration.

blocker_groups.required_original_contract: Original Scavenger enemy-ammo pickup achievement report.
blocker_groups.missing_contract: Retained scripts update scavengerPickedUp locally; candidate scavenger/resupply event names are rejected by original ProcessParams.

blocker_groups.required_original_contract: Successful enemy-equipment hack producer plus first-argument semantics and Spotter perk snapshot.
blocker_groups.missing_contract: Hack packing and native Spotter27 are verified; a successful equipment-hack caller and the meaning of Param0 remain unverified.

blocker_groups.required_original_contract: Per-kill native Kill Chain eligibility attached to killstreak earnings.
blocker_groups.missing_contract: Terminal killstreak_end aggregates kills without a loadout perk snapshot; it cannot prove Kill Chain eligibility for those kills.

blocker_groups.required_original_contract: Exact original barrel remapping/classification and distinction from integral suppression.
blocker_groups.missing_contract: Generic attachment packing does not prove the requested unsuppressed barrel family.

blocker_groups.required_original_contract: Original operator/faction selection mapping for the specified faction slot.
blocker_groups.missing_contract: A numeric operator ID alone does not prove Golem is selected in the requested faction/slot.

blocker_groups.required_original_contract: Victim proximity to smoke at the kill.
blocker_groups.missing_contract: The retained Insmoke modifier describes the attacker; using it would credit a different condition.

blocker_groups.required_original_contract: Exact native attachment remapping for Cronen LP945 Mini Reflex and Scout optic.
blocker_groups.missing_contract: Native family collapse/reticle class does not establish these requested named optic identities.

blocker_groups.required_original_contract: Original IAV/APC/Little Bird actor/weapon and vehicle destruction identity contracts.
blocker_groups.missing_contract: A generic actor/victim vehicle bit does not prove the exact vehicle, turret, runover, or one distinct destruction.

blocker_groups.required_original_contract: Kill-or-assist reports with native attacker vehicle state.
blocker_groups.missing_contract: Original assist packet contains zero modifier words and no vehicle-state field. Counting only kills would omit qualifying assists.

blocker_groups.required_original_contract: One unique enemy-occupied vehicle destruction report.
blocker_groups.missing_contract: Player-kill vehicle explosion/victim flags do not identify one destruction; counting occupants would overcount.

blocker_groups.required_original_contract: Eligible public co-op operation family, operation identity/completion, and stage-specific actors/actions.
blocker_groups.missing_contract: Retained agent/weapon/operator bits and accepted cp_complete do not establish public operation ownership or successful operation completion; survival/trial cannot substitute.

blocker_groups.required_original_contract: Original rapid grouping/consumption, exact event occurrence ordering and stage-specific weapon/optic qualifiers.
blocker_groups.missing_contract: Native script rearms a 4-second wait after kills, but emitted challenge packets carry no rapid counter; authoritative timestamps/order and consumption are unproven.

blocker_groups.required_original_contract: Ordered owner kills/deaths and reset/consumption rules for each requested repeated streak.
blocker_groups.missing_contract: Native kill/death arrival ordering and repeat/reset semantics are not proven by packet acceptance.

blocker_groups.required_original_contract: Two ordered qualifying pistol headshots in one continuous native life.
blocker_groups.missing_contract: Authoritative kill/death ordering and reset at activation/start/death/end still need integration evidence. This target1 criterion does not require a time window.

blocker_groups.required_original_contract: Exact native 60-second window origin/boundaries, timestamp precision and overlapping/repeated-window policy.
blocker_groups.missing_contract: The 60-second producer/window/counter and repeated consumption semantics remain unverified.
